releases.author: surranov
releases.description:
Interaction polish:

- Comments and the legend now always open as a centered modal with a close button - on desktop too. No more clipped tooltips near screen edges; long content scrolls inside the card.
- Comment modal title shows the full date with a localized weekday (2026-07-31 · FR).
- New corner toolbar: legend, expand all and collapse all buttons in Obsidian toolbar style.
- Default cursor across the chart; pointer only on interactive elements.
- Open modals are cleaned up when the plugin unloads.
